Now the big `updateIssue` handler. I need to convert it — replacing all `req.` references, converting `req.actor.type === "agent"` checks, and all `res.json()`/`res.status().json()` to `return Response.json()`. The key changes:
- `req.body` → `body` (parsed once with `await ctx.json()`)
- `req.params.id` → `ctx.param("id")`
- `req.actor.type` → `ctx.actor?.type`
- `req.actor.agentId` → `(ctx.actor?.type === "agent" ? ctx.actor.agentId : null)`
- `assertAgentIssueMutationAllowed(req, res, existing)` → `await assertAgentIssueMutationAllowed(ctx, existing)` (now throws)
- `assertExplicitResumeIntentAllowed(req, res, existing)` → `await assertExplicitResumeIntentAllowed(ctx, existing)` (now throws)
- `respondClosedIssueExecutionWorkspace(res, ...)` → `return closedIssueExecutionWorkspaceResponse(...)`
- All `res.status(N).json(...)` / `return` pairs → `return Response.json(..., { status: N })`
- `res.json(...)` → `return Response.json(...)`
